name: corvo-nfse
description: Corvo NFS-e platform monorepo: web, API, and worker.

scripts.install:services: yarn --cwd api install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd web install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.lint: yarn --cwd api lint:check && yarn --cwd web lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn --cwd api typecheck && yarn --cwd web typecheck
scripts.check: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f api/docker-compose.yml --profile storage up -d --wait
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f api/docker-compose.yml --profile storage down
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose --env-file api/.env -f api/docker-compose.yml --profile storage logs -f
scripts.graphify: yarn --cwd api graphify && graphify update web
scripts.deploy:up: yarn deploy:config && docker compose --env-file deploy/.env -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 180
scripts.deploy:config: node scripts/check-deploy-env.mjs && docker compose --env-file deploy/.env -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config --quiet
scripts.local:up: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.local -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.local.yml up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 180
scripts.local:down: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.local -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.local.yml down
scripts.local:logs: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.local -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.local.yml logs -f
scripts.local:config: docker compose --env-file deploy/.env.local -f deploy/docker-compose.yml -f deploy/docker-compose.local.yml config --quiet
